name: go-modernize
description: > Modernize Go code to use current language features and standard library additions. Covers generics, log/slog, errors.Join, slices/maps packages, range-over-func, and iterators introduced in Go 1.21-1.23+. Use when: "modernize", "update to modern Go", "use generics", "replace interface{}", "upgrade Go version", "slog", "errors.Join", "range over func", "iterators". Do NOT use for: general code style (use go-coding-standards), error handling philosophy (use go-error-handling), or logging archite
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 一款 Go 代码现代化工具，可将旧代码迁移到 1.21–1.23+ 的新语法与标准库，适合版本升级和淘汰过时写法。
